# Lifecycle Traceability Checklist: Link Pull Requests to Source Issues

**Purpose**: Review whether the requirements fully and clearly define non-closing PR/issue traceability and safe lifecycle behavior
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for both PR-to-issue and issue-to-PR discoverability? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the specification define the one-reference invariant for both initial PR creation and every later PR update? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements documented for initial creation, revision, merge, and close-without-merge lifecycle paths? [Completeness, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the same-repository boundary explicitly documented for the originating issue and pull request? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the required pull-request-template and tracking-reference obligations both specified without leaving precedence ambiguous? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the selected non-closing relationship form stated precisely enough to distinguish it from GitHub closing keywords and manually linked issues? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Is “one clear tracking relationship” quantified as exactly one PR-body reference rather than an unspecified number of links? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Contract §Required output]
- [ ] CHK008 Is responsibility for issue closure clearly assigned to merged-PR workflow handling or an authorized human, independently of the tracking reference? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the source of the issue number defined clearly enough to prevent references to an issue in another repository? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Required output]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Are the non-closing relationship requirements consistent across the user stories, functional requirements, assumptions, and tracking contract? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 Are idempotency requirements consistent between repeated workflow resumptions, PR revisions, and the exactly-once body contract? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-004, Contract §Required output]
- [ ] CHK012 Does explicit issue closure after merge remain consistent with the requirement that merging alone causes no closure attributable to the tracking relationship? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can reciprocal discoverability be objectively evaluated from the measurable outcomes without relying on undefined notions of “associated” or “linked”? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK014 Can the absence of automatic closure be attributed specifically to the tracking reference across both merge and close-without-merge scenarios? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK015 Can duplicate-reference prevention be objectively measured after repeated PR updates? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are recovery requirements defined for a resumed workflow whose existing PR body already contains the tracking reference? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Are exception requirements defined for a PR body that cannot simultaneously satisfy the repository template and tracking-reference contract? [Coverage, Contract §Failure handling]
- [ ] CHK018 Are retry requirements explicit enough to preserve a single reference after partial failure or repeated create/update attempts? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Is close-without-merge behavior fully specified, including that the issue stays open for an explicit revise, replace, or cancel decision? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK020 Is reliance on GitHub’s native autolinking and reciprocal cross-reference presentation documented as an external dependency? [Dependency, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the assumption of one pull request per issue branch documented and consistent with duplicate-prevention requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the workflow-policy ownership boundary documented consistently with the product contract’s tracker-write boundary? [Dependency, Plan §Summary, Constitution IV]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
